sentences.en: Blessed is the one who expects nothing, never being disillusioned.
sentences.zh: 1. 幸运的是那些不抱任何期望的人，永远不会感到失望。

sentences.en: Disillusion can become itself an illusion if we rest in it.
sentences.zh: 2. 如果我们沉溺其中，那么这种醒悟也可能变成一种幻觉。

sentences.en: Blessed is he who expects nothing, for he will never be disillusioned.
sentences.zh: 3. 幸运的是那些不抱任何期望的人，因为他们永远不会感到失望。
